comment: Acceptance case for an invite-only pilot (REL-055..057, REL-131, REL-133). Synthetic accounts and content only. It cannot run today: the server has no accounts, sessions or invitations. pilot_check.py validates it and probes a LOCAL server for anonymous access.

A.label: synthetic learner A
A.invite: <invite token A, issued by the owner>

B.label: synthetic learner B
B.invite: <invite token B, issued by the owner>

steps.expect: session for A; invite A marked used
refused (409 or 410); no session; no account change

steps.request: redeem an invite past its expiry
POST /captures (capture_id synthetic-a-1, same id, different content)
steps.expect: 201 for B: capture ids are per account, never a cross-account 409 that reveals A's id
404, identical to a missing id (no existence leak)
B's next request is 401; B's data kept for the retention decision

steps.request: flh-daily.sh backup, then restore into a fresh data directory
steps.expect: inventory READY; every account row and ownership column restored

steps.request: repeat R1, R2, X1, X2 after the restore
steps.expect: the same results as before the backup

steps.request: use B's old session after the restore
steps.expect: 401: a restore never revives a revoked account or session
